Closed Room Type — new room type for sealed, branded, highlighted rooms.

PRD: docs/superpowers/PRD/2026-08-19-closed-room-type/prd.md
Brief: docs/superpowers/PRD/2026-08-19-closed-room-type/brief.md

RESULT

Branch: design/closed-room-type

Scope

Add Closed as a room type. When a selected room is changed to Closed, the Selected Room controls automatically show color and logo options. The color changes the room shell and the related room walls. The logo appears above the room, fits inside the room footprint (contain-style) with padding from the outer edges.

When a room becomes Closed, incompatible objects strictly inside it are removed automatically. Doors and windows on the room boundary may remain. After conversion, users cannot add doors, windows, points, or shapes strictly inside the Closed room.

In scope

  1. Closed as a selectable room type.
  2. Color controls shown only for Closed rooms.
  3. Logo controls shown only for Closed rooms.
  4. Selected color applied to the closed room shell + related room walls.
  5. Contained, padded logo above the closed room.
  6. Auto-remove incompatible objects strictly inside the room on conversion.
  7. Boundary doors and windows remain.
  8. Block new incompatible objects inside a Closed room.
  9. Clear, non-technical feedback after cleanup; reversible via existing undo.

Out of scope

  1. Color or logo controls on normal rooms, hallways, or open areas.
  2. Removing boundary doors or windows.
  3. Manual logo positioning or cropping tools.
  4. Replacing shape tools.
  5. Changes to publishing, billing, sharing, account, route, or search behavior.

Functional Requirements

ID Requirement Priority
R1 Users can change a selected room type to Closed. Must
R2 Closed appears alongside the existing room type choices. Must
R3 Color controls appear automatically when the selected room is Closed. Must
R4 Logo controls appear automatically when the selected room is Closed. Must
R5 Color controls are hidden for non-Closed rooms. Must
R6 Logo controls are hidden for non-Closed rooms. Must
R7 Only Closed rooms can receive a room color. Must
R8 The closed room color changes the room shell. Must
R9 The closed room color changes the related room walls. Must
R10 Only Closed rooms can show a logo above the room. Must
R11 The logo fits inside the room footprint with padding from the outer edges. Must
R12 Existing points strictly inside the room are removed when the room becomes Closed. Must
R13 Existing rectangle, circle, and polygon shapes strictly inside the room are removed when the room becomes Closed. Must
R14 Existing doors strictly inside the room are removed when the room becomes Closed. Must
R15 Existing windows strictly inside the room are removed when the room becomes Closed. Must
R16 Boundary doors and windows may remain. Must
R17 Users cannot add points strictly inside a Closed room. Must
R18 Users cannot add rectangle, circle, or polygon shapes strictly inside a Closed room. Must
R19 Users cannot add doors strictly inside a Closed room. Must
R20 Users cannot add windows strictly inside a Closed room. Must
R21 Users receive clear feedback when objects are removed during conversion to Closed. Should
R22 Changing a room away from Closed hides the Closed-only controls. Must
R23 Existing room selection, rename, height, and type controls remain available where appropriate. Must
R24 Normal rooms, hallways, and open areas keep their existing behavior. Must

Edge cases

  • Very small rooms — prefer a smaller logo or no visible logo over a distorted/overflowing one.
  • Irregular shapes — fit the logo in the usable room area; never stretch, crop, or push it into the wall edge.
  • Overlapping rooms — rules apply to the selected room; cleanup and blocking are based on strictly-inside the selected Closed room.
  • No logo — a Closed room can exist without one; the color still applies.
  • No color — a Closed room uses a clear default color until the user picks another.

Acceptance Checklist

  • Closed is available as a room type.
  • Selected Room shows color controls when the selected room is Closed.
  • Selected Room hides color controls when the selected room is not Closed.
  • Selected Room shows logo controls when the selected room is Closed.
  • Selected Room hides logo controls when the selected room is not Closed.
  • Only Closed rooms can use a room color.
  • Closed room color changes the room shell.
  • Closed room color changes the related room walls.
  • Only Closed rooms can show a logo above the room.
  • Logo fits inside the room footprint with padding.
  • Closed rooms can exist without a logo.
  • Closed rooms can use a default color.
  • Points strictly inside a room are removed when it becomes Closed.
  • Rectangle, circle, and polygon shapes strictly inside a room are removed when it becomes Closed.
  • Doors strictly inside a room are removed when it becomes Closed.
  • Windows strictly inside a room are removed when it becomes Closed.
  • Boundary doors and windows may remain.
  • Users cannot add points inside a Closed room.
  • Users cannot add rectangle, circle, or polygon shapes inside a Closed room.
  • Users cannot add doors inside a Closed room.
  • Users cannot add windows inside a Closed room.
  • Users receive clear feedback when objects are removed during conversion.
  • Undo can reverse a mistaken Closed room change.
  • Normal rooms, hallways, and open areas continue working as before.

Design and frontend integration for Event Highlights, per:

  • PRD: docs/superpowers/PRD/2026-08-19-event-highlights/prd.md
  • Brief: docs/superpowers/PRD/2026-08-19-event-highlights/brief.md

Event is a new highlight type with title, description, photos, a schedule and an optional place. It is managed from Editor Map mode under a new Highlights section (Information | Event), and surfaced to visitors in preview and live through an Event button, an Event panel, and a related-events strip inside Information cards.

RESULT

Branch: design/event-highlights

Data layer

  • src/lib/events/status.ts — derived status (Scheduled / Happening now / Expired) computed against the building-local wall clock, plus ordering, formatting and validation. Status is never stored (R26).
  • src/lib/events/places.ts — eligible-place enumeration (areas and shapes that already have Information, R22) and invalid/deleted-place detection (§7).
  • src/store/useMapStore.types.ts — EventHighlight and EventPlace types.
  • src/store/mapStore/editorSlice.ts — eventRecords plus addEvent, updateEvent, deleteEvent, unlinkEventPlace; deleting an Information record also clears events pointing at it.
  • src/lib/persistence/wizardState.ts — events ride the existing project snapshot, so preview, /v/[key] and /embed/[key] get them with no new backend API (Out Of Scope #5).

Editor

  • src/components/editor/panel/HighlightsSection.tsx — Building / Floor / Highlights sidebar, type dropdown with icon, title and counter, one search field, one add button (R1–R5).
  • src/components/editor/panel/EventListSection.tsx — event rows with status rail and label, linked count, expand to linked place, unlink, edit, delete. Expired events stay here on purpose (R6–R9).
  • src/components/editor/EventModal.tsx and src/components/editor/event-modal/* — Basic, Media, Date and Place tabs, live status pill in the header, validation routed to the tab that owns the problem (R14–R25).

Preview and live

  • src/components/editor/preview/PreviewControls.tsx — Event button between Direction and the Building dropdown, with a count badge and a live dot (R29, R30).
  • src/components/editor/preview/EventPanel.tsx — search, ordered list (happening now before later scheduled), photo navigation and full viewer, collapsed description, Place button (R31–R38).
  • src/components/editor/preview/PreviewInfoCard.tsx — related scheduled and happening-now events, selecting one opens the Event panel focused on that event (R39–R41).
  • src/components/editor/map-markers/MapObjectMarkers.tsx — objects linked to an active event carry an event badge (R27, R28).

Verification

  • src/lib/events/__tests__/status.test.ts — boundary minutes, Open 24 hours, ordering, validation, photo cap.
  • pnpm exec tsc --noEmit and pnpm lint clean; pnpm test green apart from one pre-existing failure in src/lib/mappedin-editor/__tests__/convert.test.ts (missing samples/ fixture, unrelated to this work).
  • Standalone showcase page: /design-preview/event-highlights.

Fixes made along the way

  • src/components/ui/popover.tsx — added positionerClassName (same contract as SelectContent). The positioner is isolate z-50, so a popover inside a z-60 modal could not be lifted from the popup and rendered behind the modal. Applied in the Event modal Place tab and in AddLevelModal (Wall source), which had the same defect.

Not included

  • Recurring events, multiple place links, links to points / doors / windows / access / safety markers, visitor editing, new backend REST APIs, and event analytics — all Non-Goals in the PRD.
